title: 2.1-Tool report subScript call
text:
1
Sub script call on tool report
When generating the tool report, there may be a need to add some additional information that was not
foreseen in the template.
In this case, we can create a supplementary script and call this script when generating the report.

-- 1 of 14 --

2
Path definitions
• The Addins path in the settings we will call in this document <ADDINS>
• The Automation Center path in the settings we will call in this document <AUTOMATION>

-- 2 of 14 --

3
New script
• Create a new script and insert all needed functions

-- 3 of 14 --

4
The script will be called two times by the tool report
o For each Job list
o End of process

-- 4 of 14 --

5
For each Job List
The Subscript Master of your customized script will be called for each Job List.

-- 5 of 14 --

6
End of Process
The Subscript Finish of your customized script will be called at the end of the Process.

-- 6 of 14 --

7
Testing script
As an example, a script was created that contains a Master subscript and a Finish subscript

-- 7 of 14 --

8
Runtime script
The customized script must be a Runtime script, otherwise it will fail.
• Create a Runtime script

-- 8 of 14 --

9
Tool report app
After creating the Runtime script, an XML and hms file will be created in your app folder
<AUTOMATION>\Apps
Let’s copy these files and past these files on:
<AUTOMATION>\REPORTS\toolReports\apps
Maybe the folder apps do not exist in your computer.
If this is your case, just create a new folder named as apps.

-- 9 of 14 --

10
Copy folder
Copy the folder Testing_script (RUNTIME)
We can find this folder on:
C:\Users\Public\Documents\OPENMIND\USERS\<CURRENT_USER>\AutomationCenter\<VARIANTS>
Past folder
Past the folder Testing_script (RUNTIME) on:
• <AUTOMATION>\REPORTS\toolReports\report_templates\OM_REPORT_CUSTOM\

-- 10 of 14 --

11
Customer Script activation
• Open the file (ToolReport_OM_REPORT_CUSTOM.xlsx)
This file can be found on:
<AUTOMATION>\REPORTS\toolReports\report_templates\<REPORT_NAME>
• Go to Optimizing TAB and Activate the Customer Script (0=Deactivate / 1=Activate)

-- 11 of 14 --

12
• Type the name of the script to be called

-- 12 of 14 --

13
Delete Roaming
Before executing the tool Report configuration, it is recommended to delete the Roaming folder
• Open the file explorer and type %appdata%
• Go to Roaming\OPEN MIND\AutomationCenter\<VERSION>
• Delete everything inside this folder (process_apps, process_report_template and
process_scripts)

-- 13 of 14 --

14
Final step
• Start the report configuration and run the report

-- 14 of 14 --
